mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at the Verona Area High School with temperatures feeling like 61 degrees under a Waning Gibbous moon.

The city has shared important updates regarding road construction on Highway M near the future Aldi site, which will involve a closure from October 6 through October 9, as well as information on early absentee voting available at City Hall leading up to the November 3 election.

There is a busy schedule today with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and live music at Paddy Mac's, plus look out for Hop Haus trivia tomorrow.
On September 14, a 21-year-old Sun Prairie man was taken into custody and booked into jail for resisting an officer following a report of retail theft in the 100 block of North Main Street.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Double Strawberry, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
